text:
The Ducks arrive in New Jersey on game three of a four-game road trip, 0-2-0 so far, and winless in four after Tuesday's 3-2 loss at NYI. They're also without Ryan Poehling, and Leo Carlsson has moved into his spot beside Nesterenko and Killorn, while Nikita Klepov and Judd Caulfield are playing more. Caulfield is day-to-day and could return. The Devils beat COL 4-3 at home and are 3-2-0 in their last five, though their record understates how they've played: they've taken 61% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) at five on five, against 43% for ANA, and finishing and goaltending have cost them.

The matchup tilts toward New Jersey in chance creation and prevention, and the power play and penalty kill both favor the Devils. ANA takes 4.2 penalties a game, which keeps handing opponents power plays. In net, projected starter Lukas Dostal (ANA) is at +2.9 goals saved above expected this season (how many goals he's stopped beyond what the shots should have allowed) but was at -3.71 last season. Projected NJD starter Jake Allen is at -3.35 this season after +5.39 last year. Our model has the Devils scoring 3.45 goals tonight to ANA's 2.88.

Watch Jack Hughes (37% to score, 73% for a point) and Cutter Gauthier (34% to score). Luke Evangelista is one assist from 100 career assists. One of Ice Sheet's under-the-radar picks is Timo Meier: his third-line shots have been dangerous, with 3.1 expected goals in his last nine games, and ANA give up the fourth-most expected goals per 60 in the league.
